falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent (adjusted for pattern) would invalidate the bottom formation, proving this was not a bottom and the pattern match failed

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score of 41 typically accompanies VIX compression; sustained VIX spike above 35 would confirm panic continuation, not bottoming, invalidating the bottom call

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield falls below 3.50% on a daily close
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-quality bid of this magnitude would signal recession/depression repricing, contradicting the cyclical bottom thesis and indicating systemic stress beyond a normal bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
